broadcasts.message: normalize.js ready: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single space, trim. No other transformations. Faithful to input meaning.

tokenizer.js implemented: calls injected normalize(text), extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, returns array in order. No stopwords or negation filtering. Ready for pipeline integration.

pipeline.js ready. Uses Object.create(null) to avoid prototype collisions. unique preserves first-seen order. text is tokens joined by single space. Let me know if tokenize returns anything unexpected.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 1 complete. My job: implement normalize.js with NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse/trim, no other changes. Tokenizer/pipeline are peers' responsibility. I must not shadow injected normalize/tokenize. Return JSON with files/memory/message.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 1: I own tokenizer.js. Must call injected normalize(text), then regex [A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*, return array. No shadowing. Keep tokens in order. Next rounds: ensure compatibility with pipeline.js expectations. No special cases.
private_memories.integrator: Round 1: I own pipeline.js. Interface: processText(text) calls injected tokenize(text). Return {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. Must handle prototype names (constructor) by using Object.create(null) for frequencies and plain array for unique. text = tokens.join(' '). No shadowing of tokenize. Next rounds: keep stable, verify with peers.
